name: Elder Grove · Vine Gate
_design: Elder Grove zone (level-designer 2026-11-24; zone elder_tree, order 4). Generated by tools/maps/build_elder_grove.gd (edit the script, not this file): the goblin courtyard board (same bounds, spawns, no cover) on a floating island deep in an ancient giant-tree forest: mossy loam board, cushion-moss margins, walls of rotting stumps and gnarled roots north/east/west, an open cliff in front with ferns and mushrooms only, soft green-gold sunlight baked as dapples through the leaves. A great arch of twisted vines and old wood breaks the north root wall: the way into the grove. A mossy flagstone path runs from the gate south across the board, the elder tree leans in from the north-west corner, a ring of mossy standing stones and lanterns (the shrine) guards the west margin, corner tree north-east, ferns and mushrooms on the open front. Monster ids here are a PLACEHOLDER fixture (family-neutral old monsters: the elder family does not exist yet); the zone's journey will bring the real waves onto the spots in list order.
_arena: Board 16 x 9 m, the goblin courtyard's (same spawns, no cover: logic/auto_pilot.gd walks straight at its target). Nothing stands on the board (roots and stones on it are flat inlays under 0.1 m); trees, walls and the shrine are on the island margins, the front (camera side) is an open cliff.
_spots: Spot roles in order: melee, melee, melee, melee, knight, melee, archer, mage
